# Chabod Cleaning Services

> Family-owned cleaning company in San Antonio, TX, founded 2018.
> Services: short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO) turnover cleaning, residential
> house cleaning, and deep cleaning.

## Services
- [STR/Airbnb Turnover Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/str-cleaning): Same-day turnover cleaning (subject to availability) for Airbnb and VRBO hosts in San Antonio.
- [Residential House Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/residential-cleaning): Recurring and one-time house cleaning with a consistent assigned team.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/deep-cleaning): Detailed deep cleaning covering grout, baseboards, and appliances.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/commercial-cleaning): Commercial deep cleaning and recurring facility resets for San Antonio offices, retail, restaurants and other businesses, with a written scope of work for each site and a direct line to the owner.
- [Commercial service areas](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/commercial-cleaning-service-areas): The San Antonio-area cities where commercial deep cleaning is offered.

## Free tools
- [Airbnb and Vrbo Fee Change Calculator](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/tools/fee-calculator): Free calculator for San Antonio short-term rental hosts. Enter a nightly rate and cleaning fee to see the new price that keeps your payout after Airbnb's 15.5% host fee (Sept 15, 2026) and Vrbo's 12% commission (Oct 29, 2026). Add ?platform=vrbo to open it on Vrbo.

## San Antonio holiday guides (Nov 2026)
- [Thanksgiving Cleaning in San Antonio: Choose the Rooms That Matter and Book With a Written List](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/blog/thanksgiving-cleaning-san-antonio-rooms-that-matter): Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, 2026 — the most useful thing to hand a cleaner is a short written priority list of the rooms guests will use, what's off limits, and a backup date.
- [Thanksgiving Airbnb Turnover Coverage in San Antonio: Confirm Dates Before You Promise Guests](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/blog/thanksgiving-airbnb-turnover-coverage-san-antonio): Do not treat a cleaner as covered for Thanksgiving until they have accepted the specific dates in writing.
- [What a Backup Cleaner Needs Before Thanksgiving Week (San Antonio Host Checklist)](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/blog/backup-airbnb-cleaner-thanksgiving-checklist-san-antonio): A backup cleaner is someone who has accepted your specific dates, not someone whose number you saved.
- [November 21 on Broadway: Keep Your Home-Cleaning Arrival Flexible](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/blog/november-21-broadway-home-cleaning-arrival-san-antonio): UIW's 40th Light the Way festival is Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 4301 Broadway; no published street-closure window was found, so give your cleaner legal parking and a flexible arrival plan.
- [Broadway Holiday Arrivals: One Guest-and-Cleaner Access Note for November 21](https://chabodcleaningservices.com/blog/broadway-holiday-arrivals-guest-cleaner-access-note-san-antonio): If you host near Broadway or Alamo Heights, write two separate access notes for Saturday, November 21 — one for guests and one for the cleaner.
